fixes.explanation: Verse 37 says the Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth. The text adds that there were about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children. That's a LOT of people on the move, and I bet somebody in that crowd was already wondering if they were there yet.

It's actually False. Verse 39 says the people "…had not prepared any provisions for themselves." They were driven out so fast that they couldn't delay, so they baked the dough they carried out into unleavened loaves. Picture a big cookie order being due right now while the flour is still in the bag. That's how fast they had to move.

problems.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.
The comparison to a batch with no timer and no warning doesn't clearly match leaving without prepared provisions. It's unclear what the baker is supposed to picture.
